name: EtnProduct Umarket saleU payout
summary: The Umarket contract's saleU() paid out USDT for U tokens the attacker had obtained for free by registering a product through Etnshop/EtnProduct and burning LP into the pair, because saleU() never validated how the U balance was acquired.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.
